mapper.sql: BOND_ID, BOND_CODE, BOND_NAME, BOND_TYPE, ISSUE_PRICE, FACE_VALUE, COUPON_RATE, ISSUE_AMOUNT, ACTUAL_AMOUNT, ISSUE_START_DATE, ISSUE_END_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, TERM, PAYMENT_FREQUENCY, LISTING_EXCHANGE, UNDERWRITER, RATING_AGENCY, CREDIT_RATING, ISSUE_STATUS, REMAINING_AMOUNT, TOTAL_INTEREST_PAID, CURRENCY, OPERATOR, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_BY, DELETE_FLAG

sql.where:
DELETE_FLAG = 0
AND BOND_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bondCode}, '%')
AND BOND_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bondName}, '%')
AND BOND_TYPE = #{bondType}
AND ISSUE_STATUS = #{issueStatus}
AND ISSUE_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND ISSUE_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TBL_BOND_FINANCING
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_BOND_FINANCING WHERE BOND_ID = #{bondId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
mapper.insert:
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
INSERT INTO TBL_BOND_FINANCING ( BOND_CODE, BOND_NAME, BOND_TYPE, ISSUE_PRICE, FACE_VALUE, COUPON_RATE, ISSUE_AMOUNT, ACTUAL_AMOUNT, ISSUE_START_DATE, ISSUE_END_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, TERM, PAYMENT_FREQUENCY, LISTING_EXCHANGE, UNDERWRITER, RATING_AGENCY, CREDIT_RATING, ISSUE_STATUS, REMAINING_AMOUNT, TOTAL_INTEREST_PAID, CURRENCY, OPERATOR, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_BY, DELETE_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{bondCode}, #{bondName}, #{bondType}, #{issuePrice}, #{faceValue}, #{couponRate}, #{issueAmount}, #{actualAmount}, #{issueStartDate}, #{issueEndDate}, #{maturityDate}, #{term}, #{paymentFrequency}, #{listingExchange}, #{underwriter}, #{ratingAgency}, #{creditRating}, #{issueStatus}, #{remainingAmount}, #{totalInterestPaid}, #{currency}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as ISSUE_AMOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN ISSUE_STATUS = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as REMAINING_AMOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN ISSUE_STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as TOTAL_INTEREST_PAID, SUM(ISSUE_AMOUNT) as TERM FROM TBL_BOND_FINANCING WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
